selectionMode.range: pick a start date and an end date

rules.selectionMode: Use range only for start/end pairs; value and defaultValue then hold two dates and the field renders two inputs.
rules.invalid: Set invalid together with a visible error message near the field; DatePicker only toggles the visual/aria state.
rules.Calendar: min, max and the day/month/year navigation behave like the standalone Calendar guide; DatePicker adds only the label, input, trigger, clear button and popover around that same grid.
rules.clear: The clear control only renders once a value is set; there is no separate prop to force it.
